title: NumericFacet
description: A numeric range facet for a commerce search surface. Renders numeric range values and dispatches toggleSelect, clearAllActiveValues, applyCustomRange, showMoreValues, and showLessValues to refine results.

NumericFacetState.title: NumericFacetState
NumericFacetState.description: The current numeric facet state. Owned exclusively by the backend.

field.description: The index field this facet queries.

values.description: The numeric range values available for this facet.

customRange.description: The currently applied custom range, or null when none is active. Mutually exclusive with selected values.

hasActiveValues.description: Whether at least one range value is not in the idle state.

canShowMoreValues.description: Whether more values can be shown.

canShowLessValues.description: Whether fewer values can be shown.

domain.description: The optional numeric domain (min/max) of the facet.

NumericFacetValue.title: NumericFacetValue
NumericFacetValue.description: A single numeric range value within a numeric facet.

start.description: The inclusive lower bound of the range.

end.description: The upper bound of the range.

numberOfResults.description: The number of results matching this range.

state.description: The selection state of this facet value (idle or selected; exclusion is not supported).

NumericFacetCustomRange.title: NumericFacetCustomRange
NumericFacetCustomRange.description: A custom numeric range applied by the user, with its result count.

start.description: The inclusive lower bound of the custom range.

end.description: The upper bound of the custom range.

numberOfResults.description: The number of results matching this custom range.

NumericFacetDomain.title: NumericFacetDomain
NumericFacetDomain.description: The numeric domain bounds of a numeric facet.

min.description: The minimum value of the domain.

max.description: The maximum value of the domain.

NumericFacetToggleSelectAction.title: numericFacetToggleSelect
NumericFacetToggleSelectAction.description: Toggles the selection of a numeric range value.

start.description: The inclusive lower bound of the range to toggle.

end.description: The upper bound of the range to toggle.

NumericFacetToggleSingleSelectAction.title: numericFacetToggleSingleSelect
NumericFacetToggleSingleSelectAction.description: Toggles the selection of a range value, deselecting all other values (single-select behavior).

start.description: The inclusive lower bound of the range to single-select.

end.description: The upper bound of the range to single-select.

NumericFacetClearAllActiveValuesAction.title: numericFacetClearAllActiveValues
NumericFacetClearAllActiveValuesAction.description: Resets all numeric range values to the idle state, clearing every selection.

NumericFacetApplyCustomRangeAction.title: numericFacetApplyCustomRange
NumericFacetApplyCustomRangeAction.description: Applies a single custom numeric range, clearing any selected displayed ranges.

start.description: The inclusive lower bound of the custom range.

end.description: The upper bound of the custom range.

NumericFacetShowMoreValuesAction.title: numericFacetShowMoreValues
NumericFacetShowMoreValuesAction.description: Increases the number of numeric range values shown.

NumericFacetShowLessValuesAction.title: numericFacetShowLessValues
NumericFacetShowLessValuesAction.description: Decreases the number of numeric range values shown.
